scene.brief: Full-window Three.js solar system with a starfield background, orbiting planets and their paths, and the existing HUD controls at the screen edges. Choosing the Earth focus option eases the camera to a flattering slightly-elevated close-up in which Earth fills roughly two-thirds of the viewport height, with the Sun kept outside the frame. During that focus a soft cool blue-white directional fill from the camera side lifts the camera-facing hemisphere, with a modest ambient floor and brightened surface so blue oceans and green continents read clearly against the dark limb. Leaving Earth focus eases the previous lighting intensities and camera framing back over roughly half a second. All other bodies keep their current appearance and lighting.

checkEvidence.excerpt: so blue oceans and green continents are clearly visible.
